#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only GitHub development inventory. No branch/PR/Issue mutations."""
import datetime as dt
import json
import os
import sys
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request

REPO = os.environ["GITHUB_REPOSITORY"]
TOKEN = os.environ["GITHUB_TOKEN"]
NOW = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
STALE_DAYS = int(os.environ.get("STALE_DAYS", "14"))
API = "https://api.github.com"

def get(path):
    req = urllib.request.Request(API + path, headers={
        "Authorization": "Bearer " + TOKEN,
        "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
        "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28",
        "User-Agent": "development-inventory-readonly",
    })
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as response:
        return json.load(response)

def pages(path):
    result = []
    page = 1
    while True:
        separator = "&" if "?" in path else "?"
        batch = get(path + separator + "per_page=100&page=" + str(page))
        if not isinstance(batch, list):
            raise RuntimeError("Unexpected API response")
        result.extend(batch)
        if len(batch) < 100:
            return result
        page += 1

def age(timestamp):
    if not timestamp:
        return None
    updated = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    return (NOW - updated).days

def main():
    repo = urllib.parse.quote(REPO, safe="/")
    metadata = get("/repos/" + repo)
    default = metadata["default_branch"]
    branches = pages("/repos/" + repo + "/branches")
    all_prs = pages("/repos/" + repo + "/pulls?state=all")
    prs = [p for p in all_prs if p["state"] == "open"]
    issues = [item for item in pages("/repos/" + repo + "/issues?state=open") if "pull_request" not in item]
    pr_heads = {p["head"]["ref"] for p in prs if p["head"]["repo"] and p["head"]["repo"]["full_name"] == REPO}
    historical_heads = {p["head"]["ref"] for p in all_prs if p["head"]["repo"] and p["head"]["repo"]["full_name"] == REPO}
    findings = []
    for branch in branches:
        name = branch["name"]
        if name == default:
            continue
        # No-PR does NOT mean unfinished. Report only as a review candidate.
        if name not in pr_heads:
            findings.append({"type": "branch_without_open_pr", "name": name,
                             "historical_pr_found": name in historical_heads,
                             "url": "https://github.com/" + REPO + "/tree/" + urllib.parse.quote(name, safe="")})
    stale_prs = [{"number": p["number"], "title": p["title"], "days": age(p["updated_at"]),
                  "url": p["html_url"]} for p in prs if age(p["updated_at"]) is not None and age(p["updated_at"]) >= STALE_DAYS]
    stale_issues = [{"number": i["number"], "title": i["title"], "days": age(i["updated_at"]),
                     "url": i["html_url"]} for i in issues if age(i["updated_at"]) is not None and age(i["updated_at"]) >= STALE_DAYS]
    report = {"repository": REPO, "generated_at": NOW.isoformat(), "default_branch": default,
              "branch_count": len(branches), "open_pr_count": len(prs),
              "open_issue_count": len(issues), "historical_pr_count": len(all_prs), "review_candidates": findings,
              "stale_prs": stale_prs, "stale_issues": stale_issues,
              "caveat": "Candidates are NOT proof of unfinished work. Compare main, merged/closed PRs, and canonical ledger before action."}
    # Stable snapshot for comparison across successful scheduled/manual runs.
    report["snapshot"] = {
        "branches": {b["name"]: b.get("commit", {}).get("sha") for b in branches},
        "prs": {str(p["number"]): {"state": ("merged" if p.get("merged_at") else p["state"]),
                                  "head": p["head"].get("sha"), "updated_at": p["updated_at"],
                                  "title": p.get("title", ""), "body": (p.get("body") or "")[:2000],
                                  "head_ref": p["head"].get("ref", "")}
                for p in all_prs},
        "issues": {str(i["number"]): {"state": "open", "updated_at": i["updated_at"]} for i in issues},
    }
    os.makedirs("inventory-output", exist_ok=True)
    with open("inventory-output/report.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(report, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    summary = ["# Development inventory (read-only)", "",
               "Repository: " + REPO, "Generated (UTC): " + NOW.isoformat(), "",
               "| Metric | Count |", "|---|---:|",
               "| Branches including default | " + str(len(branches)) + " |",
               "| Open PRs | " + str(len(prs)) + " |",
               "| Open issues | " + str(len(issues)) + " |",
               "| Branches without open PR (review only) | " + str(len(findings)) + " |",
               "| Stale PRs (>= " + str(STALE_DAYS) + " days) | " + str(len(stale_prs)) + " |",
               "| Stale issues | " + str(len(stale_issues)) + " |", "",
               "**Do not mark branches unfinished or delete them based on this report.**",
               "Consult the project's canonical ledger, closed/merged PRs and main code first.", "",
               "## Stale PRs"]
    summary.extend("- [#" + str(p["number"]) + "](" + p["url"] + ") (" + str(p["days"]) + "d): " + p["title"].replace("\n", " ") for p in stale_prs)
    summary.append("\n## Stale issues")
    summary.extend("- [#" + str(i["number"]) + "](" + i["url"] + ") (" + str(i["days"]) + "d): " + i["title"].replace("\n", " ") for i in stale_issues)
    summary.append("\nBranch candidates are available in report.json artifact.")
    text = "\n".join(summary) + "\n"
    with open("inventory-output/summary.md", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)
    with open(os.environ.get("GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY", "/dev/null"), "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)
    print(text)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except (urllib.error.URLError, KeyError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as error:
        print("Inventory failed: " + str(error), file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a deterministic, review-only GitHub facts section from inventory report."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

START = "<!-- INVENTORY_FACTS_START -->"
END = "<!-- INVENTORY_FACTS_END -->"

def render(report):
    prs = report.get("snapshot", {}).get("prs", {})
    lines = ["## GitHub自動取得の事実（確認用）", "",
             "> この欄はPRメタデータの記録であり、開発完了・本番反映の認定ではありません。", "",
             "| PR | タイトル | 状態 | head SHA | 更新日時 |",
             "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |"]
    for number, pr in sorted(prs.items(), key=lambda item: int(item[0]) if str(item[0]).isdigit() else -1):
        if not str(number).isdigit() or not isinstance(pr, dict):
            continue
        if str(pr.get("head_ref", "")).startswith("automation/ledger-facts-"):
            continue
        state = str(pr.get("state", "unknown")).replace("|", "/").replace("\n", " ")
        sha = str(pr.get("head", ""))[:40]
        updated = str(pr.get("updated_at", ""))[:35]
        title = " ".join(str(pr.get("title", "")).split()).replace("|", "/")[:120]
        lines.append(f"| #{number} | {title} | {state} | `{sha}` | {updated} |")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

def update(ledger, report):
    section = START + "\n" + render(report) + END
    if START in ledger or END in ledger:
        if ledger.count(START) != 1 or ledger.count(END) != 1 or ledger.index(START) > ledger.index(END):
            raise ValueError("Invalid managed markers; refuse to change ledger")
        return ledger[:ledger.index(START)] + section + ledger[ledger.index(END) + len(END):]
    return ledger.rstrip() + "\n\n" + section + "\n"

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--report", default="inventory-output/report.json")
    parser.add_argument("--ledger", default="docs/DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md")
    parser.add_argument("--output", default="inventory-output/ledger-proposed.md")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    report = json.loads(Path(args.report).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(report.get("snapshot", {}).get("prs"), dict):
        raise ValueError("PR snapshot missing; refuse to propose ledger update")
    proposed = update(Path(args.ledger).read_text(encoding="utf-8"), report)
    target = Path(args.output)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(proposed, encoding="utf-8")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Offline tests for the read-only inventory; no GitHub token or network required."""
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import pathlib
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

SCRIPT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "scripts" / "development_inventory.py"
os.environ.update(GITHUB_REPOSITORY="example/demo")
os.environ.setdefault("GITHUB_TOKEN", "offline-test-token")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("development_inventory", SCRIPT)
inventory = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(inventory)

class InventoryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_age_and_missing(self):
        self.assertIsNone(inventory.age(None))
        self.assertEqual(inventory.age(inventory.NOW.isoformat()), 0)

    def test_pagination(self):
        calls = []
        def fake_get(path):
            calls.append(path)
            return [{"name": str(i)} for i in range(100)] if path.rsplit("page=", 1)[-1] == "1" else [{"name": "last"}]
        with patch.object(inventory, "get", side_effect=fake_get):
            result = inventory.pages("/repos/example/demo/branches")
        self.assertEqual(len(result), 101)
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 2)

    def test_pagination_multiple_full_pages(self):
        calls = []
        def fake_get(path):
            calls.append(path)
            page = int(path.rsplit("page=", 1)[-1])
            if page <= 2:
                return [{"name": "branch-%s-%s" % (page, i)} for i in range(100)]
            return [{"name": "branch-last"}]
        with patch.object(inventory, "get", side_effect=fake_get):
            result = inventory.pages("/repos/example/demo/pulls?state=all")
        self.assertEqual(len(result), 201)
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 3)
        self.assertTrue(all("state=all" in path for path in calls))
        self.assertEqual(result[-1]["name"], "branch-last")

    def test_empty_page_terminates_pagination(self):
        with patch.object(inventory, "get", return_value=[]) as fake_get:
            result = inventory.pages("/repos/example/demo/issues?state=open")
        self.assertEqual(result, [])
        fake_get.assert_called_once_with("/repos/example/demo/issues?state=open&per_page=100&page=1")

    def test_pr_and_issue_pagination_are_independent(self):
        calls = []
        def fake_get(path):
            calls.append(path)
            page = int(path.rsplit("page=", 1)[-1])
            if "/pulls?" in path:
                return [{"number": i} for i in range(100)] if page == 1 else [{"number": 101}]
            if "/issues?" in path:
                return [{"number": i} for i in range(100)] if page == 1 else [{"number": 102}]
            raise AssertionError(path)
        with patch.object(inventory, "get", side_effect=fake_get):
            prs = inventory.pages("/repos/example/demo/pulls?state=all")
            issues = inventory.pages("/repos/example/demo/issues?state=open")
        self.assertEqual(len(prs), 101)
        self.assertEqual(len(issues), 101)
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 4)

    def test_closed_pr_history_is_retained(self):
        old = "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"
        closed = {"number": 8, "state": "closed", "title": "Done",
                  "updated_at": old, "html_url": "https://github.com/example/demo/pull/8",
                  "head": {"ref": "feature/done", "repo": {"full_name": "example/demo"}}}
        def fake_pages(path):
            if "/branches" in path:
                return [{"name": "main"}, {"name": "feature/done"}]
            if "/pulls?" in path:
                return [closed]
            if "/issues?" in path:
                return []
            raise AssertionError(path)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            current = os.getcwd()
            try:
                os.chdir(tmp)
                with patch.object(inventory, "get", return_value={"default_branch": "main"}), patch.object(inventory, "pages", side_effect=fake_pages):
                    inventory.main()
                with open("inventory-output/report.json", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    result = json.load(f)
            finally:
                os.chdir(current)
        self.assertEqual(result["open_pr_count"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(result["historical_pr_count"], 1)
        self.assertTrue(result["review_candidates"][0]["historical_pr_found"])

    def test_report_candidates_are_not_completion_claims(self):
        old = "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"
        recent = inventory.NOW.isoformat()
        pr = {"number": 12, "state": "open", "title": "Open PR", "updated_at": old,
              "html_url": "https://github.com/example/demo/pull/12",
              "head": {"ref": "feature/open", "repo": {"full_name": "example/demo"}}}
        issue = {"number": 13, "title": "Open issue", "updated_at": recent,
                 "html_url": "https://github.com/example/demo/issues/13"}
        def fake_pages(path):
            if "/branches" in path:
                return [{"name": "main"}, {"name": "feature/open"}, {"name": "research/archive"}]
            if "/pulls?" in path:
                return [pr]
            if "/issues?" in path:
                return [issue, {"pull_request": {}, **issue}]
            raise AssertionError(path)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            current = os.getcwd()
            try:
                os.chdir(tmp)
                with patch.object(inventory, "get", return_value={"default_branch": "main"}), patch.object(inventory, "pages", side_effect=fake_pages):
                    inventory.main()
                with open("inventory-output/report.json", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    result = json.load(f)
            finally:
                os.chdir(current)
        self.assertEqual(result["branch_count"], 3)
        self.assertEqual(result["open_issue_count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual([x["name"] for x in result["review_candidates"]], ["research/archive"])
        self.assertEqual(len(result["stale_prs"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(result["stale_issues"]), 0)
        self.assertIn("NOT proof", result["caveat"])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
import json
import os

import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
import scripts.development_inventory_delta as delta
from scripts.development_inventory_delta import compare

class DeltaTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_changes_and_unchanged(self):
        old = {"snapshot": {"branches": {"main": "a", "old": "x"}, "prs": {"1": {"state": "open"}}, "issues": {}}}
        new = {"snapshot": {"branches": {"main": "a", "new": "y"}, "prs": {"1": {"state": "merged"}}, "issues": {"2": {"state": "open"}}}}
        changes = compare(old, new)
        self.assertEqual(len(changes), 4)
        self.assertEqual({(x["type"], x["id"], x["change"]) for x in changes},
                         {("branches", "old", "absent_from_snapshot"),
                          ("branches", "new", "added"),
                          ("prs", "1", "changed"),
                          ("issues", "2", "added")})

    def test_http_401_preserves_report_and_marks_delta_unavailable(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            cwd = os.getcwd()
            try:
                os.chdir(tmp)
                Path("inventory-output").mkdir()
                Path("inventory-output/report.json").write_text(
                    json.dumps({"snapshot": {"branches": {}, "prs": {}, "issues": {}}}))
                with patch.object(delta, "previous_snapshot",
                                  side_effect=urllib.error.HTTPError("test", 401, "Unauthorized", {}, None)):
                    delta.main()
                result = json.loads(Path("inventory-output/delta.json").read_text())
                self.assertEqual(result["status"], "comparison_unavailable")
                self.assertIn("401", result["note"])
                self.assertTrue(Path("inventory-output/report.json").exists())
            finally:
                os.chdir(cwd)

    def test_cross_host_redirect_does_not_forward_token(self):
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            "https://api.github.com/repos/example/demo/actions/artifacts/123/zip",
            headers={"Authorization": "Bearer test-secret"})
        handler = delta.SafeRedirect()
        redirected = handler.redirect_request(
            req, None, 302, "Found", {},
            "https://artifact-storage.example.test/file.zip?sig=dummy")
        self.assertIsNotNone(redirected)
        self.assertNotIn("Authorization", redirected.headers)
        self.assertNotIn("Authorization", redirected.unredirected_hdrs)

    def test_triage_does_not_assign_completion(self):
        changes = [{"type": "branches", "id": "feature/new-thing", "change": "added"}]
        with patch.object(delta, "api", return_value=[]):

        self.assertIsNone(suggestions[0]["proposed_status"])

    def test_pr_title_matches_index_without_status_change(self):

        suggestions = delta.classify_candidates(changes, "| M-01 | ラウンジ | 進行中 |")
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["candidate_case_ids"], ["M-01"])
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["ledger_action"], "review_only")
        self.assertIsNone(suggestions[0]["proposed_status"])

    def test_inventory_maintenance_is_not_product_case(self):
        changes = [{"type": "prs", "id": "44", "change": "added",
                    "after": {"title": "inventory triage", "body": "", "head_ref": "fix"}}]
        with patch.object(delta, "api", return_value=[{"filename": "scripts/development_inventory_delta.py"}]):
            suggestions = delta.classify_candidates(changes, "| M-01 | ラウンジ | x |")
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["classification"], "automation_maintenance")
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["candidate_case_ids"], [])
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["file_evidence"]["status"], "complete")

    def test_file_evidence_does_not_change_ledger(self):

            suggestions = delta.classify_candidates(changes, "| M-01 | ラウンジ | x |")
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["ledger_action"], "review_only")
        self.assertIsNone(suggestions[0]["proposed_status"])
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["file_evidence"]["paths"], ["src/lounge/ui.ts"])

    def test_identical(self):

        self.assertEqual(compare(snapshot, snapshot), [])

class DeltaStringDetailsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_branch_sha_string_does_not_crash(self):
        change = {"type": "branches", "id": "fix/example", "change": "changed",
                  "before": "a" * 40, "after": "b" * 40}
        with patch.object(delta, "REPO", ""):
            result = delta.classify_candidates([change], "| M-01 | 会話 |")
        self.assertEqual(len(result), 1)
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["source_type"], "branches")
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["ledger_action"], "review_only")

    def test_pr_dict_still_classifies(self):
        change = {"type": "prs", "id": "123", "change": "changed",
                  "after": {"title": "conversation update", "head_ref": "feat/conversation"}}
        with patch.object(delta, "REPO", ""):
            result = delta.classify_candidates([change], "| M-01 | conversation |")
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["candidate_case_ids"], ["M-01"])

    def test_missing_details_does_not_crash(self):
        change = {"type": "issues", "id": "5", "change": "absent_from_snapshot",
                  "before": None, "after": None}
        with patch.object(delta, "REPO", ""):
            result = delta.classify_candidates([change], "")
        self.assertEqual(len(result), 1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

+

+---
+
+## 2026-11-02 競合AIコンパニオンの開発思想比較（設計参考・実装指示ではない）
+
+> **位置づけ**：2026-11-02の会話で共有・検討した競合研究の要点。下記の他社機能・日付は調査メモとして記録し、外部公開・仕様確定時には公式一次情報を再確認すること。**Misakiの実装完了を示さず、競合の内部実装を推定で断定しない。**
+>
+> **最優先方針**：当面は**美咲一人の会話・人格・感情・記憶・ラウンジ体験を完成**させる。二人目以降の実装は後回し。将来のマルチキャラ化で破壊的移行が必要にならない識別子・所有境界・拡張点のみ維持する。
+
+### 今回の参考事例
+
+| サービス | 公開情報・議論の要点 | Misakiへの示唆 | 採用判断 |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Kindroid | 2026-10-28頃のグループ専用ジャーナル：参加者で共有し、他の会話空間へ無条件に持ち出さない設計思想 | 同じ世界の**出来事の事実**と、キャラ別の**解釈・感情・関係性**を分離。会話空間・参加/目撃・明示共有・ユーザー所有者でアクセス判定する | **既存設計の維持・確認**。他キャラの実装は後回し |
+| Nomi | Mind Map等、人物・場所・出来事の関連付け、会話の場による共有境界、重要情報の補助入力 | 「保存した」ことと「適切に思い出す」ことを区別。関連度・重要度・頻度・出典・秘密の境界を使う | **美咲単独の自然な想起**を将来評価。既存実装を先に棚卸し |
+| Replika | 人格・好み・ユーザーとの関係を継続的に個別化する方向性 | **人格の核**と、ユーザーごとに成長する関係・感情・話し方を分ける | **既存方針を維持** |
+| Character.AI | Facts と重要な物語・固定したい記憶を区別する方向性 | ユーザーに関する事実と、**美咲と一緒に経験した想い出**を区別。ユーザーが「覚えていて」と指定できる余地を残す | **将来検討**。匿名の24時間上限・同意/削除を優先 |
+| Nemini | 2026-10-30〜31頃、他サービスの会話履歴から記憶を引き継ぐ機能、会話内の小さな共同ツール | 他サービスの履歴は「美咲との共通体験」と誤認しない。出典・発言者・本人確認と選択的同意に基づくインポートが望ましい | **後回し**。自動全件移行は採用しない |
+| Shubiduba | 2026-10-28頃、音楽という共通体験に特化した複数AIフレンド | モードの多機能化より、仕事・旅行・天気など**一緒に経験した時間に沿った会話**を磨く。関係の深さを課金で売ることとは分ける | **今は追加モード不要**。美咲の会話品質優先 |
+
+### Misakiの設計原則（再確認）
+
+1. **事実は共有できても、想い出の解釈はそれぞれ違う。** 事実の記録とキャラクター別の感情・評価を独立させる。感情が薄れたり変化しても、出来事を捏造・改変しない。
+2. **「誰が知っているか」に加えて「誰との関係・どの場で知ったか」を保持する。** 所有者、character ID、参加/目撃、明示共有、会話/グループの出典、権限、期限を別々に検証する。異なるユーザーの個人情報は完全に分離。
+3. **記憶保存 ≠ 記憶想起。** 美咲が以前の話を毎回持ち出すのではなく、関連性・重要度・自然さ・頻度制限・秘密性を考慮して想起する。事実と推測を混同しない。
+4. **人格の核 ≠ 関係の成長。** 美咲自身の価値観を維持しつつ、相手との経験で距離感・感情・気遣いが変化する。
+5. **外部取り込み情報 ≠ 美咲と共有した想い出。** 将来移行機能を検討する場合、出典・話者・本人同意・取り込み候補の確認を必須とする。
+6. **「忘れる」は全参照経路で守る。** 匿名の情報別24時間上限、削除抑止、派生データ、再送、通知、復旧経路を迂回させない。競合動向を理由に安全条件を緩めない。
+
+### 開発への反映範囲（2026-11-02時点）
+
+- **直近**：PR #131の匿名セッション復旧を、復旧後の会話・認証を保持できる互換復旧手段とともに安全に仕上げ、実機で送信→返信→再読込を確認。その後、既存の**新しい全画面ラウンジ**へ導線を統一し、美咲単独の会話品質・想起を評価する。
+- **今確保する拡張点**：キャラクターID、ユーザー所有境界、イベント出典、参加/目撃/共有権限、事実と解釈の分離、版・期限・削除の契約。**既存フェーズ1ローカル基盤を再利用し、未検証の本番DB統合を既成事実にしない。**
+- **当面しない**：他4人の人格の仮作成・マルチキャラ相互会話・グループ記憶の本番導入・外部会話一括移行・専門モード追加・競合の機能模倣。
+- **継続的な比較研究**：Kindroid、Nomi、Replika、Character.AI、Nemini、Shubiduba等の公式更新・開発者発言・利用者評価を定期的に調査。**事実・開発思想の解釈・Misakiへの提案を区別**し、既報の重複を避ける。報告は設計の判断材料であり、コード変更を自動承認するものではない。
+
+**担当区分**：Misaki/アメふるの自動棚卸し・台帳更新・イベント駆動の実装保守は**別の開発管理自動化プロジェクト**が担当。Misaki本体は重複修正せず、本体のマージ/デプロイに影響する場合のみ連携する。
+
+
+---
+
+## 2026-11-02 ChatGPT Work利用回数の節約（運用方針）
+
+> **目的**：Workの利用制限を踏まえ、**報告・再確認だけのWorkをできるだけ発生させず、実装が前進する単位でまとめて依頼する**。安全確認を省略する趣旨ではなく、確認を実作業へ組み込む運用変更である。
+
+1. **単純なReadOnly確認は原則として専用Workを起こさない。** GitHubのPR・CI・SHA・既知の差分・Vercelの状態など、ソラ側の接続ツールで取得できる範囲はソラが直接確認し、職人さんのWorkを消費しない。
+2. **実装→必要最小限の照合→テスト→CI→（許可範囲内の）反映→結果報告を、可能な限り一度のWorkにまとめる。** 小さな確認だけを理由とした途中停止・再依頼・重複監査を避ける。
+3. **既に成功した検証を理由なく何度もやり直さない。** ソースや環境が変わった場合の影響範囲に絞り、必要な回帰検証は省略しない。
+4. **重要な操作の承認境界は維持する。** mainマージ/本番デプロイ、本番DB・migration・環境変数の変更、既存データの削除、実モデル送信、検証用書込みなどは、承認された範囲内でのみ実行。承認されていない次の工程には進まない。
+5. **問題がない場合は承認済み工程を連続実行し、最後に簡潔な結果を報告する。** ブロッカー・破壊的影響・承認範囲超過が生じた場合だけ停止して相談する。
+6. **他プロジェクトの担当範囲を重複調査しない。** Misaki・アメふるの自動棚卸し/開発台帳更新/イベント駆動自動化は独立プロジェクトが担当。Misaki本体では本体のマージ/デプロイへの影響だけ確認する。
+
+**指示作成時の原則**：ソラは「確認だけのWork」より「具体的な完成条件を持ったWork」を優先し、同じ質問・同じ監査をユーザーに繰り返させない。最終判断に必要な事実と未検証項目は正確に区別する。

# 美咲ラウンジ動画自動表示・開発台帳（2026-10-29）

## 確認済み基準
- main: `0b5ab6758861e2a4916b6b82ec196ed579559d0a`（作業開始時点）
- 対象: `public/lab/transparent-lounge/index.html`、本番確認ページ `/lab/transparent-lounge/`
- 既存ラウンジのソファ位置・拡大率・左右仮カード・スワイプ・動画終了/スキップ動作を維持する。
- 既存チャット、DB、RPC、Relationship Engineは変更しない。
- 元実験ブランチ `experiment/transparent-lounge-20261027` は main と分岐（ahead 26/behind 4）。そのまま main にマージしない。

## 今回実装したHTML変更（未公開）
- 手動 WebP 選択UI/JSを削除し、`/lab/transparent-lounge/misaki-lounge-24fps.webp` を自動表示する参照に変更。
- 古い横型プレビューMP4参照を廃止し、`/lab/transparent-lounge/misaki-opening-vertical-21s.mp4` を参照。
- 縦型video要素を `aspect-ratio:9/16`、モバイル画面高上限で表示。
- ソファ背景は既存実験ブランチの素材URLを維持（新ブランチ main には背景画像がないため）。
- HTMLのみ変更。**動画ファイル2本はまだGitHubの公開フォルダに存在しない。**

## 素材／検証
- ラウンジ: `misaki-lounge-24fps.webp`（元: `misaki_lounge_24fps(1).webp`）、約4.40MB、624×352、24fps/約9秒、ユーザーiPhoneでループと透過確認済み。
- オープニング: `misaki-opening-vertical-21s.mp4`（元: `misaki-opening-vertical-21s-iphone(1).mp4`）、2,936,765 bytes、512×910、21.000秒、30fps、H.264/AAC。
- 配置場所（GitHub）: `public/lab/transparent-lounge/`
- ユーザーへ提供したZIP: `misaki-lounge-deploy-assets.zip`（上記2ファイルを所定の相対パスで収録）。
- ブラウザ配信後、WebP 200 + image/webp、MP4 200 + video/mp4、再生・スキップ・終了・画面遷移をiPhone実機で確認する。

## 残作業／リリース判定
1. ZIP内のバイナリ2本をGitHubの本ブランチへコミットする（GitHubテキストAPIではこの環境からバイナリを直接転送できず、未実施）。
2. PRの変更ファイルがHTML + 2アセット + 文書だけであることを確認し、マージ後にVercel本番配信を検証。
3. iPhone実機で、9秒アニメーションループ、縦21秒再生、スキップ、動画終了→既存確認画面を確認。
4. 次の工程で既存チャット入口を調査・接続する。チャットの複製実装は禁止。

**現時点では本番公開・実機検証未完了。動画ファイル未配置のままPRをマージしない。**

## 2026-10-29 追記：素材アップロードの現物確認
- 作業ブランチに `public/lab/transparent-lounge/misaki_lounge_24fps.webp`（4,402,574 bytes）および `misaki_lounge_12fps.webp`（2,375,926 bytes）を確認。
- HTMLのWebP参照を実在する `misaki_lounge_24fps.webp` に修正済み。旧手動選択は不要。
- `misaki-opening-vertical-21s.mp4` は**依然として未配置**（リポジトリツリー確認）。縦21秒オープニング再生はまだ検証不可。
- 21秒MP4が同一フォルダにアップロードされるまでマージ・本番公開しない。

## 2026-10-29 追記：21秒MP4到着・HTML参照修正
- GitHubの同フォルダに `misaki-opening-vertical-21s-iphone.mp4`（2,936,765 bytes）を確認。以前アップロード済みのユーザー素材とファイルサイズが一致する。
- HTMLのMP4参照を実際のアップロード名 `misaki-opening-vertical-21s-iphone.mp4` に修正。WebP参照も実在する `misaki_lounge_24fps.webp`。
- 以前の文書内の「動画2本未配置」「MP4未配置」は当時の記録。現時点では2本とも配置済み。
- 次のゲート: GitHub CI成功、PR取り込み、本番HTTP/再生/iPhone実機確認。

## 2026-10-29 縦型オープニングを画面いっぱいに表示
- iPhoneで選択後すぐに全画面相当のWebダイアログ（`position:fixed; inset:0; 100dvh`）を開き、動画を `object-fit:contain` で画面内最大表示。
- ネイティブ動画コントロールを廃止し、縮小／PiP／動画単体のフルスクリーン解除などの意図しない操作を抑制。端末・ブラウザの機能自体を完全禁止する保証ではない。
- 画面下部の「再生する」（自動再生失敗時）と「スキップ」は継続。終了後の確認画面は従来どおり。
- 再生状況の通常表示は映像の邪魔にならないよう消し、読み込み失敗・バッファ時に状態を表示。
- iPhone実機で画面サイズ・再生・終了・スキップ・音声・回転を検証する。

"""Regression tests for mixed GitHub snapshot types."""
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
from scripts import development_inventory_delta as delta

class DeltaStringDetailsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_branch_sha_string_does_not_crash(self):
        change = {"type": "branches", "id": "fix/example", "change": "changed",
                  "before": "a" * 40, "after": "b" * 40}
        with patch.object(delta, "REPO", ""):
            result = delta.classify_candidates([change], "| M-01 | 会話 |")
        self.assertEqual(len(result), 1)
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["source_type"], "branches")
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["ledger_action"], "review_only")

    def test_pr_dict_still_classifies(self):
        change = {"type": "prs", "id": "123", "change": "changed",
                  "after": {"title": "conversation update", "head_ref": "feat/conversation"}}
        with patch.object(delta, "REPO", ""):
            result = delta.classify_candidates([change], "| M-01 | conversation |")
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["candidate_case_ids"], ["M-01"])

    def test_missing_details_does_not_crash(self):
        change = {"type": "issues", "id": "5", "change": "absent_from_snapshot",
                  "before": None, "after": None}
        with patch.object(delta, "REPO", ""):
            result = delta.classify_candidates([change], "")
        self.assertEqual(len(result), 1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

| M-05 | 旧監査証拠 | 保全 | 棚卸し担当ソラ | `docs/audits/LEGACY_AUDIT_FOLLOWUP_20261101.md` | 必要な証拠のみ索引化 |
| M-06 | 旧Safari・関係性診断ブランチ2件 | 整理候補・未削除 | 棚卸し担当ソラ | `docs/audits/BRANCH_TRIAGE_20261101.md` | 参照先確認後に削除可否を相談 |

## 運用
- 毎日10:17 JSTにread-onlyのGitHub Actions棚卸し。`development-inventory` artifactに `report.json` / `summary.md` を30日保持。**台帳へ自動反映はされない**。
- 週次は新規・消滅・状態変化の候補を確認し、この索引に**変更があった案件だけ**追記・更新する。週次詳細照合は自動化済みではない。
- 未整理ブランチの原資料: [一次分類](audits/BRANCH_TRIAGE_20261101.md) / [初回調査](audits/INVENTORY_RECONCILIATION_20261101.md)。全件の履歴はGitHub Actions成果物を参照。
- 実装、予測精度の検証、DB、Push、デプロイ、ブランチ削除は担当ソラの領域。ここでは発見事項・所在・引継ぎ先だけを記録する。

## 日次レポートと週次差分の確認手順
1. GitHub Actionsの `Development inventory (read-only)` の最新**成功**runを開き、`development-inventory` artifactの `report.json` / `summary.md` を取得する。失敗・未実行なら前回値を最新値と扱わず、実行日時を明記する。
2. 前回の成功runと比較する対象は、ブランチの追加・消滅・head変化、PRの新規・open/closed/merged変化、Issueの新規・状態変化、長期停滞候補の増減。**集計件数の差だけで作業完了・未統合・削除可能とは判断しない**。
3. 変化を見つけたら、対応する案件IDと証拠（PR・commit・ブランチ・run ID）を照合する。新規案件だけIDを追加し、既存案件は状態・次の一手・確認日を更新する。変更なしなら台帳の不要な書き換えはしない。
4. 旧ブランチの保全・削除判断、アプリ実装、DB、Push、本番変更は担当者と別途判断する。週次差分確認は**手順の定義のみ**で、現時点で自動実行されない。

### 更新時の最小記録
`確認日（JST） / 案件ID / 変更前→変更後 / 証拠URL・run ID / 引継ぎ先 / 次の一手 / 未確認事項`。

## 第4段階：台帳の安全な自動更新（導入前の運用契約）

- **事実ログと判断欄を分離する。** GitHub APIで確認できたPR番号・タイトル・状態・head SHA・更新日時・証拠URLのみを、機械管理の独立セクションへ追記する。開発案件の進捗、完了、本番稼働、実機確認、担当者の判断欄は変更しない。
- **PR方式を優先する。** 自動化は専用ブランチ上に更新案を生成し、差分がある場合のみ台帳更新PRを作る。初期段階は自動マージせず、実データの正確性と重複防止を確認してから限定的な自動マージを検討する。
- **証拠が不足する場合は更新しない。** 比較不能、API失敗、分類の曖昧さ、100件を超えるファイル一覧、既存台帳との競合は確認待ちとして記録する。PRマージだけで開発完了と判断しない。
- **冪等性。** PR番号とhead SHAなどの安定した識別子を使い、再実行しても同じ事実を重複追記しない。自動化自身のPRは製品開発案件へ割り当てない。
- **安全境界。** アプリコード、DB、認証、Push、デプロイ、ブランチ削除は操作しない。GitHub Actionsの書込権限は台帳更新専用ジョブに限定し、既存のread-only棚卸しは維持する。

この節は設計合意の記録であり、台帳の自動書込みが稼働していることを意味しない。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only GitHub development inventory. No branch/PR/Issue mutations."""
import datetime as dt
import json
import os
import sys
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request

REPO = os.environ["GITHUB_REPOSITORY"]
TOKEN = os.environ["GITHUB_TOKEN"]
NOW = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
STALE_DAYS = int(os.environ.get("STALE_DAYS", "14"))
API = "https://api.github.com"

def get(path):
    req = urllib.request.Request(API + path, headers={
        "Authorization": "Bearer " + TOKEN,
        "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
        "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28",
        "User-Agent": "development-inventory-readonly",
    })
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as response:
        return json.load(response)

def pages(path):
    result = []
    page = 1
    while True:
        separator = "&" if "?" in path else "?"
        batch = get(path + separator + "per_page=100&page=" + str(page))
        if not isinstance(batch, list):
            raise RuntimeError("Unexpected API response")
        result.extend(batch)
        if len(batch) < 100:
            return result
        page += 1

def age(timestamp):
    if not timestamp:
        return None
    updated = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    return (NOW - updated).days

def main():
    repo = urllib.parse.quote(REPO, safe="/")
    metadata = get("/repos/" + repo)
    default = metadata["default_branch"]
    branches = pages("/repos/" + repo + "/branches")
    all_prs = pages("/repos/" + repo + "/pulls?state=all")
    prs = [p for p in all_prs if p["state"] == "open"]
    issues = [item for item in pages("/repos/" + repo + "/issues?state=open") if "pull_request" not in item]
    pr_heads = {p["head"]["ref"] for p in prs if p["head"]["repo"] and p["head"]["repo"]["full_name"] == REPO}
    historical_heads = {p["head"]["ref"] for p in all_prs if p["head"]["repo"] and p["head"]["repo"]["full_name"] == REPO}
    findings = []
    for branch in branches:
        name = branch["name"]
        if name == default:
            continue
        # No-PR does NOT mean unfinished. Report only as a review candidate.
        if name not in pr_heads:
            findings.append({"type": "branch_without_open_pr", "name": name,
                             "historical_pr_found": name in historical_heads,
                             "url": "https://github.com/" + REPO + "/tree/" + urllib.parse.quote(name, safe="")})
    stale_prs = [{"number": p["number"], "title": p["title"], "days": age(p["updated_at"]),
                  "url": p["html_url"]} for p in prs if age(p["updated_at"]) is not None and age(p["updated_at"]) >= STALE_DAYS]
    stale_issues = [{"number": i["number"], "title": i["title"], "days": age(i["updated_at"]),
                     "url": i["html_url"]} for i in issues if age(i["updated_at"]) is not None and age(i["updated_at"]) >= STALE_DAYS]
    report = {"repository": REPO, "generated_at": NOW.isoformat(), "default_branch": default,
              "branch_count": len(branches), "open_pr_count": len(prs),
              "open_issue_count": len(issues), "historical_pr_count": len(all_prs), "review_candidates": findings,
              "stale_prs": stale_prs, "stale_issues": stale_issues,
              "caveat": "Candidates are NOT proof of unfinished work. Compare main, merged/closed PRs, and canonical ledger before action."}
    # Stable snapshot for comparison across successful scheduled/manual runs.
    report["snapshot"] = {
        "branches": {b["name"]: b.get("commit", {}).get("sha") for b in branches},
        "prs": {str(p["number"]): {"state": ("merged" if p.get("merged_at") else p["state"]),
                                  "head": p["head"].get("sha"), "updated_at": p["updated_at"],
                                  "title": p.get("title", ""), "body": (p.get("body") or "")[:2000],
                                  "head_ref": p["head"].get("ref", "")}
                for p in all_prs},
        "issues": {str(i["number"]): {"state": "open", "updated_at": i["updated_at"]} for i in issues},
    }
    os.makedirs("inventory-output", exist_ok=True)
    with open("inventory-output/report.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(report, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    summary = ["# Development inventory (read-only)", "",
               "Repository: " + REPO, "Generated (UTC): " + NOW.isoformat(), "",
               "| Metric | Count |", "|---|---:|",
               "| Branches including default | " + str(len(branches)) + " |",
               "| Open PRs | " + str(len(prs)) + " |",
               "| Open issues | " + str(len(issues)) + " |",
               "| Branches without open PR (review only) | " + str(len(findings)) + " |",
               "| Stale PRs (>= " + str(STALE_DAYS) + " days) | " + str(len(stale_prs)) + " |",
               "| Stale issues | " + str(len(stale_issues)) + " |", "",
               "**Do not mark branches unfinished or delete them based on this report.**",
               "Consult the project's canonical ledger, closed/merged PRs and main code first.", "",
               "## Stale PRs"]
    summary.extend("- [#" + str(p["number"]) + "](" + p["url"] + ") (" + str(p["days"]) + "d): " + p["title"].replace("\n", " ") for p in stale_prs)
    summary.append("\n## Stale issues")
    summary.extend("- [#" + str(i["number"]) + "](" + i["url"] + ") (" + str(i["days"]) + "d): " + i["title"].replace("\n", " ") for i in stale_issues)
    summary.append("\nBranch candidates are available in report.json artifact.")
    text = "\n".join(summary) + "\n"
    with open("inventory-output/summary.md", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)
    with open(os.environ.get("GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY", "/dev/null"), "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)
    print(text)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except (urllib.error.URLError, KeyError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as error:
        print("Inventory failed: " + str(error), file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a deterministic, review-only GitHub facts section from inventory report."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

START = "<!-- INVENTORY_FACTS_START -->"
END = "<!-- INVENTORY_FACTS_END -->"

def render(report):
    prs = report.get("snapshot", {}).get("prs", {})
    lines = ["## GitHub自動取得の事実（確認用）", "",
             "> この欄はPRメタデータの記録であり、開発完了・本番反映の認定ではありません。", "",
             "| PR | タイトル | 状態 | head SHA | 更新日時 |",
             "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |"]
    for number, pr in sorted(prs.items(), key=lambda item: int(item[0]) if str(item[0]).isdigit() else -1):
        if not str(number).isdigit() or not isinstance(pr, dict):
            continue
        if str(pr.get("head_ref", "")).startswith("automation/ledger-facts-"):
            continue
        state = str(pr.get("state", "unknown")).replace("|", "/").replace("\n", " ")
        sha = str(pr.get("head", ""))[:40]
        updated = str(pr.get("updated_at", ""))[:35]
        title = " ".join(str(pr.get("title", "")).split()).replace("|", "/")[:120]
        lines.append(f"| #{number} | {title} | {state} | `{sha}` | {updated} |")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

def update(ledger, report):
    section = START + "\n" + render(report) + END
    if START in ledger or END in ledger:
        if ledger.count(START) != 1 or ledger.count(END) != 1 or ledger.index(START) > ledger.index(END):
            raise ValueError("Invalid managed markers; refuse to change ledger")
        return ledger[:ledger.index(START)] + section + ledger[ledger.index(END) + len(END):]
    return ledger.rstrip() + "\n\n" + section + "\n"

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--report", default="inventory-output/report.json")
    parser.add_argument("--ledger", default="docs/DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md")
    parser.add_argument("--output", default="inventory-output/ledger-proposed.md")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    report = json.loads(Path(args.report).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(report.get("snapshot", {}).get("prs"), dict):
        raise ValueError("PR snapshot missing; refuse to propose ledger update")
    proposed = update(Path(args.ledger).read_text(encoding="utf-8"), report)
    target = Path(args.output)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(proposed, encoding="utf-8")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Offline tests for the read-only inventory; no GitHub token or network required."""
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import pathlib
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

SCRIPT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "scripts" / "development_inventory.py"
os.environ.update(GITHUB_REPOSITORY="example/demo")
os.environ.setdefault("GITHUB_TOKEN", "offline-test-token")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("development_inventory", SCRIPT)
inventory = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(inventory)

class InventoryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_age_and_missing(self):
        self.assertIsNone(inventory.age(None))
        self.assertEqual(inventory.age(inventory.NOW.isoformat()), 0)

    def test_pagination(self):
        calls = []
        def fake_get(path):
            calls.append(path)
            return [{"name": str(i)} for i in range(100)] if path.rsplit("page=", 1)[-1] == "1" else [{"name": "last"}]
        with patch.object(inventory, "get", side_effect=fake_get):
            result = inventory.pages("/repos/example/demo/branches")
        self.assertEqual(len(result), 101)
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 2)

    def test_pagination_multiple_full_pages(self):
        calls = []
        def fake_get(path):
            calls.append(path)
            page = int(path.rsplit("page=", 1)[-1])
            if page <= 2:
                return [{"name": "branch-%s-%s" % (page, i)} for i in range(100)]
            return [{"name": "branch-last"}]
        with patch.object(inventory, "get", side_effect=fake_get):
            result = inventory.pages("/repos/example/demo/pulls?state=all")
        self.assertEqual(len(result), 201)
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 3)
        self.assertTrue(all("state=all" in path for path in calls))
        self.assertEqual(result[-1]["name"], "branch-last")

    def test_empty_page_terminates_pagination(self):
        with patch.object(inventory, "get", return_value=[]) as fake_get:
            result = inventory.pages("/repos/example/demo/issues?state=open")
        self.assertEqual(result, [])
        fake_get.assert_called_once_with("/repos/example/demo/issues?state=open&per_page=100&page=1")

    def test_pr_and_issue_pagination_are_independent(self):
        calls = []
        def fake_get(path):
            calls.append(path)
            page = int(path.rsplit("page=", 1)[-1])
            if "/pulls?" in path:
                return [{"number": i} for i in range(100)] if page == 1 else [{"number": 101}]
            if "/issues?" in path:
                return [{"number": i} for i in range(100)] if page == 1 else [{"number": 102}]
            raise AssertionError(path)
        with patch.object(inventory, "get", side_effect=fake_get):
            prs = inventory.pages("/repos/example/demo/pulls?state=all")
            issues = inventory.pages("/repos/example/demo/issues?state=open")
        self.assertEqual(len(prs), 101)
        self.assertEqual(len(issues), 101)
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 4)

    def test_closed_pr_history_is_retained(self):
        old = "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"
        closed = {"number": 8, "state": "closed", "title": "Done",

        issue = {"number": 13, "title": "Open issue", "updated_at": recent,
                 "html_url": "https://github.com/example/demo/issues/13"}
        def fake_pages(path):
            if "/branches" in path:
                return [{"name": "main"}, {"name": "feature/open"}, {"name": "research/archive"}]
            if "/pulls?" in path:
                return [pr]
            if "/issues?" in path:
                return [issue, {"pull_request": {}, **issue}]
            raise AssertionError(path)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            current = os.getcwd()
            try:
                os.chdir(tmp)
                with patch.object(inventory, "get", return_value={"default_branch": "main"}), patch.object(inventory, "pages", side_effect=fake_pages):

                with open("inventory-output/report.json", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    result = json.load(f)
            finally:
                os.chdir(current)
        self.assertEqual(result["branch_count"], 3)
        self.assertEqual(result["open_issue_count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual([x["name"] for x in result["review_candidates"]], ["research/archive"])
        self.assertEqual(len(result["stale_prs"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(result["stale_issues"]), 0)

import unittest
import json
import os
import tempfile
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
import scripts.development_inventory_delta as delta
from scripts.development_inventory_delta import compare

class DeltaTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_changes_and_unchanged(self):
        old = {"snapshot": {"branches": {"main": "a", "old": "x"}, "prs": {"1": {"state": "open"}}, "issues": {}}}
        new = {"snapshot": {"branches": {"main": "a", "new": "y"}, "prs": {"1": {"state": "merged"}}, "issues": {"2": {"state": "open"}}}}
        changes = compare(old, new)
        self.assertEqual(len(changes), 4)
        self.assertEqual({(x["type"], x["id"], x["change"]) for x in changes},
                         {("branches", "old", "absent_from_snapshot"),
                          ("branches", "new", "added"),
                          ("prs", "1", "changed"),
                          ("issues", "2", "added")})

    def test_http_401_preserves_report_and_marks_delta_unavailable(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            cwd = os.getcwd()
            try:
                os.chdir(tmp)
                Path("inventory-output").mkdir()
                Path("inventory-output/report.json").write_text(
                    json.dumps({"snapshot": {"branches": {}, "prs": {}, "issues": {}}}))
                with patch.object(delta, "previous_snapshot",
                                  side_effect=urllib.error.HTTPError("test", 401, "Unauthorized", {}, None)):
                    delta.main()
                result = json.loads(Path("inventory-output/delta.json").read_text())
                self.assertEqual(result["status"], "comparison_unavailable")
                self.assertIn("401", result["note"])
                self.assertTrue(Path("inventory-output/report.json").exists())
            finally:
                os.chdir(cwd)

    def test_cross_host_redirect_does_not_forward_token(self):
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            "https://api.github.com/repos/example/demo/actions/artifacts/123/zip",
            headers={"Authorization": "Bearer test-secret"})
        handler = delta.SafeRedirect()
        redirected = handler.redirect_request(
            req, None, 302, "Found", {},
            "https://artifact-storage.example.test/file.zip?sig=dummy")
        self.assertIsNotNone(redirected)
        self.assertNotIn("Authorization", redirected.headers)
        self.assertNotIn("Authorization", redirected.unredirected_hdrs)

    def test_triage_does_not_assign_completion(self):
        changes = [{"type": "branches", "id": "feature/new-thing", "change": "added"}]
        with patch.object(delta, "api", return_value=[]):
            suggestions = delta.classify_candidates(changes, "| M-01 | ラウンジ | 進行中 |")
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["classification"], "needs_review")
        self.assertIsNone(suggestions[0]["proposed_status"])
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["ledger_action"], "review_only")

    def test_pr_title_matches_index_without_status_change(self):
        changes = [{"type": "prs", "id": "123", "change": "added",
                    "after": {"title": "ラウンジ", "body": "", "head_ref": "feature"}}]
        suggestions = delta.classify_candidates(changes, "| M-01 | ラウンジ | 進行中 |")
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["candidate_case_ids"], ["M-01"])
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["ledger_action"], "review_only")
        self.assertIsNone(suggestions[0]["proposed_status"])

    def test_inventory_maintenance_is_not_product_case(self):
        changes = [{"type": "prs", "id": "44", "change": "added",
                    "after": {"title": "inventory triage", "body": "", "head_ref": "fix"}}]
        with patch.object(delta, "api", return_value=[{"filename": "scripts/development_inventory_delta.py"}]):
            suggestions = delta.classify_candidates(changes, "| M-01 | ラウンジ | x |")
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["classification"], "automation_maintenance")
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["candidate_case_ids"], [])
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["file_evidence"]["status"], "complete")

    def test_file_evidence_does_not_change_ledger(self):
        changes = [{"type": "prs", "id": "45", "change": "added", "after": {}}]

            suggestions = delta.classify_candidates(changes, "| M-01 | ラウンジ | x |")

        self.assertIsNone(suggestions[0]["proposed_status"])
        self.assertEqual(suggestions[0]["file_evidence"]["paths"], ["src/lounge/ui.ts"])

    def test_identical(self):
        snapshot = {"snapshot": {"branches": {"main": "x"}, "prs": {}, "issues": {}}}
        self.assertEqual(compare(snapshot, snapshot), [])

pr-131.purpose: 会話や記憶・関係性を扱う処理の変更／通知・メール配信とその運用に関する変更／開発資産の把握・引継ぎ・レビューを支援する変更／認証・アクセス制御に関する変更／画面表示や操作に関する変更

pr-131.body:
匿名状態の読込み失敗で会話を開始できない場合に、期限切れ410と検証不能409を区別し、本人の明示操作・確認後だけ独立した匿名会話を開始する修正です。旧状態は自動削除・復活・延長・置換しません。

正常匿名・登録ユーザーの既存経路を維持します。ロード失敗中の送信と空cache上書き、期限切れrootからの応答再利用を防止します。新会話はタブ専用の認証・保存namespaceで開始し、旧token/記憶/履歴を取り込みません。復旧モードで既存Push購読を付け替えません。確認対象ログから会話本文・外部API payload・任意例外本文を除去しています。

今回追加した受付制御は、新しい独立復旧の開始前にだけno-store APIを確認します。受付OFF・通信/応答異常時は切替を拒否し、保存情報に触れません。待機中のアカウント切替も再確認します。通常匿名・登録・復旧済み匿名のauth/history/send/save/reloadは受付フラグを参照しません。初回の通常匿名アクセスも維持します。

公開コミット: 6af9501cd6e691e85cf855d843586eba4f175559
親: 64f201c037ee0d6f54f001066cb849ac3684fa40
全体tree: 258ad4493ebd529c1af96f49bc54db1e398cbdc8
承認済みローカル通常版f2c0202と8個の変更blob・全体treeが一致。既存PRの21ファイルを保持し、受付制御の4新規ファイルと既存4ファイル更新を追加しました。最初の公開21ファイルは8a6c97d+ea8a40bと照合済みです。元コミットは不変です。

mainは今回確認時点d970aba（棚卸しCI修正）。本変更には取り込まず、自動化の修正もしません。本番反映前に最新mainとの統合結果を再確認・検証します。DB/migration/env/auth方式/保存形式/依存関係/CI/人格・感情エンジン/新記憶基盤の変更なし。

GitHub CI: https://github.com/miyazaki1016/misaki/actions/runs/41379165574 — npm ci / npm test / npx tsc --noEmit / npm run buildすべて成功。PR #131と#101はDraft・未マージを再確認。

検証: 通常版・停止版とも全Node回帰374/374、npx tsc --noEmit、npm run build成功（今回再実行）。元340件+今回固有14件+harness importによる既存20件再登録。合成API/画面/認証SDK transportで送信・対応応答・保存・reload・複数tab・旧root保全・競合防止を検証。実モデル応答や本番での会話成立を証明するものではありません。

Preview: vercel.jsonのgit.deploymentEnabledでfix/anonymous-session-recoveryだけfalseを維持。停止専用のremote branch/tagは作成せず、手動Previewも起動しません。更新後にbranch/SHA双方のdeployment一覧0件を確認（pushから139秒時点）。本番はmain d970abaのREADYから変更していません。

緊急停止版の保全・取得:
- ローカル停止版64c0a92d5cb73a1f10c4d016932660d452e8abc5、branch fix/recovery-admission-stopped-localを維持。
- 停止版全体tree: f031f40180be2207d4fed976edff9639615401d0
- 通常版との差分は下記1行のみ。このPR本文に完全なパッチを保全するため、ローカル作業領域が失われても公開コミットから再構成できます。非公開コミットの取得は不要です。
- 以下をanonymous-recovery-stop.patchとして保存（UTF-8/LF）。公開コミットを取得し、別のローカルworktreeでgit apply --check → git apply。git write-tree相当の全体treeが上記停止版と一致することを確認します。パッチSHA256: 56c2c12854537417af39614597488571c882fc4b633e90b4bc8862866ea49d2e。

```diff
diff --git a/lib/recovery-admission-policy.ts b/lib/recovery-admission-policy.ts
index 915e8e2..2e296fb 100644
--- a/lib/recovery-admission-policy.ts
+++ b/lib/recovery-admission-policy.ts
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 // Server-read release switch. OFF refuses only new independent recovery starts.
 // Never use this value to gate auth hydration, history, generation or persistence.
-export const ACCEPT_NEW_ANONYMOUS_RECOVERY = true;
+export const ACCEPT_NEW_ANONYMOUS_RECOVERY = false;
```

停止・再開の手順（今回は実行しない）:
1. 最初の本番には必ず今回の受付確認を含む版を使う。停止版だけ用意して古いPR版を先に配備しない。
2. 障害時はその時点の本番source SHA・既存会話namespace・期限/replay検証が保持されていることを確認する。上の停止版は現在の候補の再現用。将来mainが進んだ場合は当時の本番sourceへフラグ1行だけ適用し、他の変更を巻き戻さない。
3. 停止差分がフラグ1行のみであること、旧状態に触れないこと、全テスト・型検査・本番buildを確認。別承認後、Preview停止を確認した経路で公開し、承認済みmain統合・既存Vercel本番Git連携で配備する。新規ブランチを無条件にpushしない。環境変数・DB・認証設定を変更しない。
4. 本番domainの/api/anonymous-recovery/admissionがaccepting:falseとno-storeを返すことを読み取り確認。既存の正常匿名・登録・復旧済み会話の継続は、別承認を得た検証セッションで送信→今回の応答→保存→再読込を個別確認。実ユーザーのデータ削除・サイトデータclear・signOut・古いtokenのコピーは行わない。
5. 再開時は当時の本番sourceの同じフラグだけtrueに戻す。差分/回帰検証・別承認後に同じ本番配備経路を使い、APIがaccepting:trueであることを確認する。
6. 停止・再開にはbuild/deployが必要で即時ではない。反映前、またはON応答取得済みの処理は完了し得る。これは運用上の受付制御であり認証providerの強制停止機能ではない。

旧main全体へのrollbackは復旧namespaceに対応せず、復旧後の会話へのアクセスと期限切れ/replay防止を保証できないため安全策としません。認証・保存形式・期限検証を保持した互換停止版または個別の前進修正を使います。docs/ANONYMOUS_SESSION_RECOVERY.mdの旧rollback記載より本手順を優先してください。追加手順書はローカル検証時点の記録として内容を維持しています。

未検証・リスク: 本番認証provider/DB/RLS/多接続競合、iPhone Safari/Chrome/アプリ内ブラウザのstorage・BFCache・CDN挙動、実モデル応答。タブ閉鎖によるsessionStorage喪失や従来の正常load期限更新規則は未解決。受付停止だけで認証/storage自体の障害は直りません。

Draft維持。mainマージ・本番デプロイ・本番DB書込・実モデル送信は別承認。PR #101は未操作・Draft/未マージを維持します。

# Anonymous session recovery

## Behavior
Healthy anonymous sessions continue through the existing APIs. Expired and unverifiable temporary state remain distinct failures. Neither failure automatically deletes state, changes the original identity or renews its expiry.

After a failed state load, sending remains disabled. The user can explicitly choose to keep the old state and start an independent conversation, with a second confirmation. A full navigation creates a new anonymous auth context in a tab-local session-storage namespace. No original auth token, temporary token, pending request, memory or history is imported. Registered users cannot invoke this recovery operation.

The new context uses the existing chat, generation, canonical persistence and relationship logic. This is not a new memory foundation. Push ownership and notification registration changes are disabled in recovery contexts.

A restored response is not proof of a new generation. Acceptance must verify the new request, corresponding response, committed history and reload independently.

## Isolation and lifetime
Reloads in the same tab retain the recovery namespace. Original tabs retain their original namespace; independently recovered tabs use different namespaces. A duplicated tab can inherit its source namespace according to browser session-storage behavior. Existing revision checks reject stale writes. Anonymous roots are validated before returning replay tokens or receipts.

Closing a recovery tab may lose its session-storage credentials. Automatic cross-device recovery is not promised. Preserved namespaces are not automatically deleted and repeated recovery may accumulate local data and anonymous auth users. Existing healthy-session expiry behavior is unchanged; this change does not implement per-item memory retention.

## Validation
- Full Node regression: 340 passing runner cases, including imported existing test registrations.
- TypeScript and Next production build: pass.
- Synthetic state/API round trips: distinct new input, corresponding scripted response, committed pair and reload; no old-state prompt contamination.
- Actual chat component with controlled hooks/HTTP: 410/409 messages, disabled send, cancellation, explicit navigation, registered-user refusal and healthy state.
- Installed auth SDK with synthetic transport: isolated auth creation, reload, separate scopes, unchanged old credentials.
- Source-level privacy checks for chat/history/canonical/persona fallback logging: no raw response, conversation or arbitrary exception payloads in reviewed entry modules.

Not verified: live auth service, production data writes, live model responses, real multi-connection Postgres races, Safari/Chrome/in-app browser layout and storage/BFCache behavior. No live services are used by the added tests.

## CI and release
The existing PR workflow runs npm ci, npm test, TypeScript and Next build. No workflow, dependency, environment variable, migration or DB configuration changes are required. Main pushes can automatically deploy through the existing Vercel connection and trigger unrelated inventory/ledger workflows. Do not merge without explicit release approval and review of the exact head.

Before release, test old anonymous and registered contexts plus a separate recovery context on Safari, Chrome and an in-app browser. Test confirm/cancel, reload, back, duplicate tab, concurrent turns and auth switching. Failed/unverifiable legacy states must remain preserved.

For a live one-round-trip check, obtain separate authorization for an isolated synthetic anonymous user, authentication/root/receipt/relationship writes and one model/usage charge. Match request ID, new response, persistence and reload without exposing message contents or credentials. No new paid contract or API key is required by this implementation.

## Rollback
Record the then-current production deployment and commit before release. On a release-related failure, route traffic to that prior production deployment and revert only this PR in a new reviewed change. Do not reset DB, auth, cache or memory and do not auto-merge preserved recovery data into an original account.

The old build does not understand recovery namespaces. New recovery conversations may be inaccessible through that old UI after rollback even though their data remains; preserving credentials alone does not guarantee restore after tab closure or logout. +5. 旧状態と復旧状態をcopy/merge/clear/signOutしない。Safariのサイトデータ削除やタブ終了による初期化を指示しない。
+6. 認証namespace、root検証、replay検証を保ったまま問題箇所を前進修正する。安全確認後、受付trueの互換版を別承認で再配備して受付再開。

+
+## 検証結果
+通常ON版: 全回帰374/374、型検査、Next production build成功。
+停止OFF版: 全回帰374/374、型検査、Next production build成功。

+- OFF/ON切替API自体でroot/token/期限/RPC回数を変更しない。

+- stale editをrevisionで拒否し、削除済みmemoryを古いtokenから生成入力へ戻さない。
+- 前工程の複数tab/再訪/replay/期限切れ/SDK隔離テストを維持。
+
+## PRとの関係
+推奨は受付確認をPR #131へ追加してから最初の本番へ入れること（今は未反映）。停止版はフラグ1行差の独立した緊急用候補としてローカル保持。停止版だけ別に保持し、PR131 clientをそのまま本番へ出す方式は、古いタブが受付確認しないので不適切。

+

+本番の実際のauth/root/receipt/競合、iPhone Safari/Chrome/アプリ内ブラウザのタブ・storage・cache・戻る、実モデル応答は未検証。storageやauthそのものが壊れた場合はフラグだけで直らない。互換性を維持した個別修正が必要。タブ閉鎖によるsessionStorage喪失や、従来の正常load期限更新挙動も今回解決しない。
+ローカルの停止版は本番で可用性を実証したdeploymentではない。未保証事項を残したまま「安全な本番rollbackを実証済み」とは言わない。

LPの6つのCTAを美咲単独ラウンジ /lounge/ に接続。既存の素材・レイアウトを再利用し、選択→縦21秒動画→終了/スキップ→既存 /chat の導線を追加します。再訪ショートカット、再生拒否・エラー、戻る/pageshow、storage拒否に対応。

チャット、認証、記憶、人格・感情・関係性、DB、API、Push、PWA、環境変数は変更なし。PR #101は変更なし。動画素材の変更なし。

# Solo entry handover — 2026-11-02 JST

## Baseline and scope
- GitHub main: `4fb0e34fb534b269382d41b8ed99c13dcf7d56df`.
- Vercel latest production: `dpl_4VUQmnaZheiS23b8zCtoUQgwkwiZ`, READY, same Git SHA. Domain alias HTTP/content and live conversation were not revalidated in this run.
- Read main overview, ledger, operations index, lounge source and open PR states. PR #101 remains Draft/unmerged.
- Local `7f42677` exists and was inspected: it opens movie BEFORE lounge, so not copied wholesale. `90da64f` package exists as ZIP: synthetic static chat, not the existing live chat; not installed as product code.

## Proposed change

name: Ledger facts proposal PR (review required)
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
concurrency:
  group: ledger-facts-proposal
  cancel-in-progress: false
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  propose:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      # Execute only on trusted main; no untrusted PR code.
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: true
      - name: Validate offline generator
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_development_ledger_proposal.py' -v
      - name: Verify safe event triggers
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_ledger_event_triggers.py' -v
      - name: Validate proposal safety checks
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_verify_ledger_proposal.py' -v
      - name: Build read-only snapshot and proposal
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          python3 scripts/development_inventory.py
          python3 scripts/development_ledger_proposal.py
          python3 scripts/verify_ledger_proposal.py
      - name: Save generated proposal for inspection
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ledger-proposal-diagnostics
          path: |
            inventory-output/report.json
            inventory-output/ledger-proposed.md
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Open review-only PR when needed
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cmp -s docs/DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md inventory-output/ledger-proposed.md && exit 0
          if gh pr list --state open --json headRefName --jq '[.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith("automation/ledger-facts-"))] | length' | grep -qv '^0$'; then
            echo 'An automation review PR is already open; leaving it for review.'
            exit 0
          fi
          branch="automation/ledger-facts-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git checkout -b "$branch"
          cp inventory-output/ledger-proposed.md docs/DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md
          git add docs/DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md
          git commit -m 'docs: propose factual GitHub PR ledger snapshot'
          git push origin "$branch"
          if ! gh pr create --base main --head "$branch" \
            --title 'docs: review GitHub PR facts in development ledger' \
            --body 'Automatically generated factual PR snapshot only. Review required; no automatic merge. Does not assert implementation, production deployment, or verification completion.'; then
            echo 'ERROR: GitHub Actions could not create the ledger PR. Check repository Actions permissions for PR creation.' >&2
            exit 1
          fi

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only GitHub development inventory. No branch/PR/Issue mutations."""
import datetime as dt
import json
import os
import sys
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request

REPO = os.environ["GITHUB_REPOSITORY"]
TOKEN = os.environ["GITHUB_TOKEN"]
NOW = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
STALE_DAYS = int(os.environ.get("STALE_DAYS", "14"))
API = "https://api.github.com"

def get(path):
    req = urllib.request.Request(API + path, headers={
        "Authorization": "Bearer " + TOKEN,
        "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
        "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28",
        "User-Agent": "development-inventory-readonly",
    })
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as response:
        return json.load(response)

def pages(path):
    result = []
    page = 1
    while True:
        separator = "&" if "?" in path else "?"
        batch = get(path + separator + "per_page=100&page=" + str(page))
        if not isinstance(batch, list):
            raise RuntimeError("Unexpected API response")
        result.extend(batch)
        if len(batch) < 100:
            return result
        page += 1

def age(timestamp):
    if not timestamp:
        return None
    updated = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    return (NOW - updated).days

def main():
    repo = urllib.parse.quote(REPO, safe="/")
    metadata = get("/repos/" + repo)
    default = metadata["default_branch"]
    branches = pages("/repos/" + repo + "/branches")
    all_prs = pages("/repos/" + repo + "/pulls?state=all")
    prs = [p for p in all_prs if p["state"] == "open"]
    issues = [item for item in pages("/repos/" + repo + "/issues?state=open") if "pull_request" not in item]
    pr_heads = {p["head"]["ref"] for p in prs if p["head"]["repo"] and p["head"]["repo"]["full_name"] == REPO}
    historical_heads = {p["head"]["ref"] for p in all_prs if p["head"]["repo"] and p["head"]["repo"]["full_name"] == REPO}
    findings = []
    for branch in branches:
        name = branch["name"]
        if name == default:
            continue
        # No-PR does NOT mean unfinished. Report only as a review candidate.
        if name not in pr_heads:
            findings.append({"type": "branch_without_open_pr", "name": name,
                             "historical_pr_found": name in historical_heads,
                             "url": "https://github.com/" + REPO + "/tree/" + urllib.parse.quote(name, safe="")})
    stale_prs = [{"number": p["number"], "title": p["title"], "days": age(p["updated_at"]),
                  "url": p["html_url"]} for p in prs if age(p["updated_at"]) is not None and age(p["updated_at"]) >= STALE_DAYS]
    stale_issues = [{"number": i["number"], "title": i["title"], "days": age(i["updated_at"]),
                     "url": i["html_url"]} for i in issues if age(i["updated_at"]) is not None and age(i["updated_at"]) >= STALE_DAYS]

              "stale_prs": stale_prs, "stale_issues": stale_issues,
              "caveat": "Candidates are NOT proof of unfinished work. Compare main, merged/closed PRs, and canonical ledger before action."}
    # Stable snapshot for comparison across successful scheduled/manual runs.
    report["snapshot"] = {
        "branches": {b["name"]: b.get("commit", {}).get("sha") for b in branches},
        "prs": {str(p["number"]): {"state": ("merged" if p.get("merged_at") else p["state"]),
                                  "head": p["head"].get("sha"), "updated_at": p["updated_at"],
                                  "title": p.get("title", ""), "body": (p.get("body") or "")[:2000],
                                  "head_ref": p["head"].get("ref", "")}
                for p in all_prs},
        "issues": {str(i["number"]): {"state": "open", "updated_at": i["updated_at"]} for i in issues},
    }
    os.makedirs("inventory-output", exist_ok=True)
    with open("inventory-output/report.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(report, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    summary = ["# Development inventory (read-only)", "",
               "Repository: " + REPO, "Generated (UTC): " + NOW.isoformat(), "",
               "| Metric | Count |", "|---|---:|",
               "| Branches including default | " + str(len(branches)) + " |",
               "| Open PRs | " + str(len(prs)) + " |",
               "| Open issues | " + str(len(issues)) + " |",
               "| Branches without open PR (review only) | " + str(len(findings)) + " |",
               "| Stale PRs (>= " + str(STALE_DAYS) + " days) | " + str(len(stale_prs)) + " |",
               "| Stale issues | " + str(len(stale_issues)) + " |", "",
               "**Do not mark branches unfinished or delete them based on this report.**",
               "Consult the project's canonical ledger, closed/merged PRs and main code first.", "",
               "## Stale PRs"]
    summary.extend("- [#" + str(p["number"]) + "](" + p["url"] + ") (" + str(p["days"]) + "d): " + p["title"].replace("\n", " ") for p in stale_prs)
    summary.append("\n## Stale issues")
    summary.extend("- [#" + str(i["number"]) + "](" + i["url"] + ") (" + str(i["days"]) + "d): " + i["title"].replace("\n", " ") for i in stale_issues)
    summary.append("\nBranch candidates are available in report.json artifact.")
    text = "\n".join(summary) + "\n"
    with open("inventory-output/summary.md", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)
    with open(os.environ.get("GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY", "/dev/null"), "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)
    print(text)

if __name__ == "__main__":

        main()
    except (urllib.error.URLError, KeyError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as error:
        print("Inventory failed: " + str(error), file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a deterministic, review-only GitHub facts section from inventory report."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

START = "<!-- INVENTORY_FACTS_START -->"
END = "<!-- INVENTORY_FACTS_END -->"

def render(report):
    prs = report.get("snapshot", {}).get("prs", {})
    lines = ["## GitHub自動取得の事実（確認用）", "",
             "> この欄はPRメタデータの記録であり、開発完了・本番反映の認定ではありません。", "",
             "| PR | タイトル | 状態 | head SHA | 更新日時 |",
             "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |"]
    for number, pr in sorted(prs.items(), key=lambda item: int(item[0]) if str(item[0]).isdigit() else -1):
        if not str(number).isdigit() or not isinstance(pr, dict):
            continue
        if str(pr.get("head_ref", "")).startswith("automation/ledger-facts-"):
            continue
        state = str(pr.get("state", "unknown")).replace("|", "/").replace("\n", " ")
        sha = str(pr.get("head", ""))[:40]
        updated = str(pr.get("updated_at", ""))[:35]
        title = " ".join(str(pr.get("title", "")).split()).replace("|", "/")[:120]
        lines.append(f"| #{number} | {title} | {state} | `{sha}` | {updated} |")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

def update(ledger, report):
    section = START + "\n" + render(report) + END
    if START in ledger or END in ledger:
        if ledger.count(START) != 1 or ledger.count(END) != 1 or ledger.index(START) > ledger.index(END):
            raise ValueError("Invalid managed markers; refuse to change ledger")
        return ledger[:ledger.index(START)] + section + ledger[ledger.index(END) + len(END):]
    return ledger.rstrip() + "\n\n" + section + "\n"

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--report", default="inventory-output/report.json")
    parser.add_argument("--ledger", default="docs/DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md")
    parser.add_argument("--output", default="inventory-output/ledger-proposed.md")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    report = json.loads(Path(args.report).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(report.get("snapshot", {}).get("prs"), dict):
        raise ValueError("PR snapshot missing; refuse to propose ledger update")
    proposed = update(Path(args.ledger).read_text(encoding="utf-8"), report)
    target = Path(args.output)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(proposed, encoding="utf-8")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

name: Ledger facts proposal PR (review required)
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
concurrency:
  group: ledger-facts-proposal
  cancel-in-progress: false
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  propose:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      # Execute only on trusted main; no untrusted PR code.
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: true
      - name: Validate offline generator
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_development_ledger_proposal.py' -v
      - name: Verify safe event triggers
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_ledger_event_triggers.py' -v
      - name: Validate proposal safety checks
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_verify_ledger_proposal.py' -v
      - name: Build read-only snapshot and proposal
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          python3 scripts/development_inventory.py
          python3 scripts/development_ledger_proposal.py
          python3 scripts/verify_ledger_proposal.py
      - name: Open review-only PR when needed
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cmp -s docs/DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md inventory-output/ledger-proposed.md && exit 0
          if gh pr list --state open --json headRefName --jq '[.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith("automation/ledger-facts-"))] | length' | grep -qv '^0$'; then
            echo 'An automation review PR is already open; leaving it for review.'
            exit 0
          fi
          branch="automation/ledger-facts-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git checkout -b "$branch"
          cp inventory-output/ledger-proposed.md docs/DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md
          git add docs/DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md
          git commit -m 'docs: propose factual GitHub PR ledger snapshot'
          git push origin "$branch"
          gh pr create --base main --head "$branch" \
            --title 'docs: review GitHub PR facts in development ledger' \
            --body 'Automatically generated factual PR snapshot only. Review required; no automatic merge. Does not assert implementation, production deployment, or verification completion.'

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Fail-closed checks before proposing any development ledger change."""
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+try:
+    from scripts.development_ledger_proposal import START, END, update
+except ModuleNotFoundError:
+    from development_ledger_proposal import START, END, update
+
+def verify(original, proposed, report):
+    if not isinstance(report, dict) or not isinstance(report.get("snapshot", {}).get("prs"), dict):
+        raise ValueError("Missing PR snapshot")
+    if not report["snapshot"]["prs"]:
+        raise ValueError("Empty PR snapshot: refuse to replace facts")
+    expected = update(original, report)
+    if proposed != expected:
+        raise ValueError("Proposal differs from deterministic generator")
+    if update(proposed, report) != proposed:
+        raise ValueError("Proposal is not idempotent")
+    if proposed.count(START) != 1 or proposed.count(END) != 1:
+        raise ValueError("Invalid managed section")
+    if len(proposed.encode("utf-8")) > 2_000_000:
+        raise ValueError("Oversized ledger proposal")
+    return True
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--report", default="inventory-output/report.json")
+    parser.add_argument("--ledger", default="docs/DEVELOPMENT_LEDGER.md")
+    parser.add_argument("--proposal", default="inventory-output/ledger-proposed.md")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    verify(Path(args.ledger).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
+           Path(args.proposal).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
+           json.loads(Path(args.report).read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only GitHub development inventory. No branch/PR/Issue mutations."""
import datetime as dt
import json
import os
import sys
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request

REPO = os.environ["GITHUB_REPOSITORY"]
TOKEN = os.environ["GITHUB_TOKEN"]
NOW = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
STALE_DAYS = int(os.environ.get("STALE_DAYS", "14"))
API = "https://api.github.com"

def get(path):
    req = urllib.request.Request(API + path, headers={
        "Authorization": "Bearer " + TOKEN,
        "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
        "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28",
        "User-Agent": "development-inventory-readonly",
    })
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as response:
        return json.load(response)

def pages(path):
    result = []
    page = 1
    while True:
        separator = "&" if "?" in path else "?"
        batch = get(path + separator + "per_page=100&page=" + str(page))
        if not isinstance(batch, list):
            raise RuntimeError("Unexpected API response")
        result.extend(batch)
        if len(batch) < 100:
            return result
        page += 1

def age(timestamp):
    if not timestamp:
        return None
    updated = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    return (NOW - updated).days

def main():
    repo = urllib.parse.quote(REPO, safe="/")
    metadata = get("/repos/" + repo)
    default = metadata["default_branch"]
    branches = pages("/repos/" + repo + "/branches")
    all_prs = pages("/repos/" + repo + "/pulls?state=all")
    prs = [p for p in all_prs if p["state"] == "open"]
    issues = [item for item in pages("/repos/" + repo + "/issues?state=open") if "pull_request" not in item]
    pr_heads = {p["head"]["ref"] for p in prs if p["head"]["repo"] and p["head"]["repo"]["full_name"] == REPO}
    historical_heads = {p["head"]["ref"] for p in all_prs if p["head"]["repo"] and p["head"]["repo"]["full_name"] == REPO}
    findings = []
    for branch in branches:
        name = branch["name"]
        if name == default:
            continue
        # No-PR does NOT mean unfinished. Report only as a review candidate.
        if name not in pr_heads:
            findings.append({"type": "branch_without_open_pr", "name": name,
                             "historical_pr_found": name in historical_heads,
                             "url": "https://github.com/" + REPO + "/tree/" + urllib.parse.quote(name, safe="")})
    stale_prs = [{"number": p["number"], "title": p["title"], "days": age(p["updated_at"]),
                  "url": p["html_url"]} for p in prs if age(p["updated_at"]) is not None and age(p["updated_at"]) >= STALE_DAYS]
    stale_issues = [{"number": i["number"], "title": i["title"], "days": age(i["updated_at"]),
                     "url": i["html_url"]} for i in issues if age(i["updated_at"]) is not None and age(i["updated_at"]) >= STALE_DAYS]
    report = {"repository": REPO, "generated_at": NOW.isoformat(), "default_branch": default,
              "branch_count": len(branches), "open_pr_count": len(prs),
              "open_issue_count": len(issues), "historical_pr_count": len(all_prs), "review_candidates": findings,
              "stale_prs": stale_prs, "stale_issues": stale_issues,
              "caveat": "Candidates are NOT proof of unfinished work. Compare main, merged/closed PRs, and canonical ledger before action."}
    # Stable snapshot for comparison across successful scheduled/manual runs.
    report["snapshot"] = {
        "branches": {b["name"]: b.get("commit", {}).get("sha") for b in branches},
        "prs": {str(p["number"]): {"state": ("merged" if p.get("merged_at") else p["state"]),
                                  "head": p["head"].get("sha"), "updated_at": p["updated_at"],
                                  "title": p.get("title", ""), "body": (p.get("body") or "")[:2000],
                                  "head_ref": p["head"].get("ref", "")}
                for p in all_prs},
        "issues": {str(i["number"]): {"state": "open", "updated_at": i["updated_at"]} for i in issues},
    }
    os.makedirs("inventory-output", exist_ok=True)
    with open("inventory-output/report.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(report, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    summary = ["# Development inventory (read-only)", "",
               "Repository: " + REPO, "Generated (UTC): " + NOW.isoformat(), "",
               "| Metric | Count |", "|---|---:|",
               "| Branches including default | " + str(len(branches)) + " |",
               "| Open PRs | " + str(len(prs)) + " |",
               "| Open issues | " + str(len(issues)) + " |",
               "| Branches without open PR (review only) | " + str(len(findings)) + " |",
               "| Stale PRs (>= " + str(STALE_DAYS) + " days) | " + str(len(stale_prs)) + " |",
               "| Stale issues | " + str(len(stale_issues)) + " |", "",
               "**Do not mark branches unfinished or delete them based on this report.**",
               "Consult the project's canonical ledger, closed/merged PRs and main code first.", "",
               "## Stale PRs"]
    summary.extend("- [#" + str(p["number"]) + "](" + p["url"] + ") (" + str(p["days"]) + "d): " + p["title"].replace("\n", " ") for p in stale_prs)
    summary.append("\n## Stale issues")
    summary.extend("- [#" + str(i["number"]) + "](" + i["url"] + ") (" + str(i["days"]) + "d): " + i["title"].replace("\n", " ") for i in stale_issues)
    summary.append("\nBranch candidates are available in report.json artifact.")
    text = "\n".join(summary) + "\n"
    with open("inventory-output/summary.md", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)
    with open(os.environ.get("GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY", "/dev/null"), "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)
    print(text)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except (urllib.error.URLError, KeyError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as error:
        print("Inventory failed: " + str(error), file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
